skill.enemy.razorbeak.rushing_bite.rule: Deal 9 plus level raw damage to the effective recipient.

animationBeats.pose: Razorbeak lowers its skull, plants both feet and fixes on the target.
The hind legs compress while the tail rises to counterbalance the launch.
The entire animal crosses the attack lane in a low straight rush.
The jaws close at the target line with a short forward impact flash.
Razorbeak lands beyond contact, pivots on one foot and returns to its combat stance.

skill.enemy.razorbeak.rushing_bite.framing: Keep the full animal, tail, feet, target body, travel lane and impact effect inside the battle safe frame for every beat.

skill.enemy.razorbeak.guard_breaking_kic.rule: Remove up to 6 Guard from the effective recipient, then deal 6 plus level raw damage through any Guard that remains. After resolution, create a Recovery Opening on Razorbeak.

recoveryOpening.createdPose: Razorbeak lands with its feet crossed, the striking hip carried past the target line and the near flank fully exposed.
recoveryOpening.activeLoop: Hold the crossed-foot silhouette with a small tail correction and one scraping outside foot; do not return to the normal ready stance.
recoveryOpening.consumedResponse: Snap the torso toward the incoming party hit, deepen the impact reaction and break the Recovery Opening marker at contact.
recoveryOpening.expiredRecovery: Plant the outside foot, swing the tail behind the spine and square both hips before the next intent is declared.

animationBeats.pose: Razorbeak turns side-on, watches the target and transfers its weight onto the near leg.
The tail snaps in the opposite direction while the hips begin a full-body pivot.
The far leg extends in a high lateral kick with the heel claw leading.
The heel claw strikes the visible guard plane; the guard effect breaks outward in large readable bronze shards.
The leg follows through past the target line while the tail stops the spin.
Razorbeak lands with crossed feet in a short skid, its head tracking the party while the striking hip remains out of line and the near flank stays exposed.

skill.enemy.razorbeak.guard_breaking_kic.framing: Keep the full animal, tail tip, both feet, target body, intact guard plane and every broken guard shard inside the battle safe frame for every beat.

text.firstObservation: The razorbeak keeps its wounded flank away from Betty. Its feet are coiled for a two-band rush.

intentTells.skill.enemy.razorbeak.rushing_bite: It lowers its skull, fixes on the weakest stance in the party and compresses both hind legs for a straight rushing bite.
intentTells.skill.enemy.razorbeak.guard_breaking_kic: It turns side-on toward the guarded combatant, lifts its tail for balance and plants the near foot for a guard-breaking kick.

text.recoveryOpening: The kick carries its hips past the target line. Until it squares its feet again, the exposed flank will take six additional raw damage from the next party hit.

art.framing: Entire animal, tail, feet, target line and lunge effect remain inside the battle safe frame.
